verdict.rationale: Brex documents a Budgets API for managing Budgets and Spend Limits, top-line budget assignment, and auto-enforced limits that block out-of-policy purchases. It also offers configurable multi-level approval routing, so budgets, card limits, and approvals together cover the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that budgets can be allocated to specific teams and projects (rather than just top-line), concrete detail on how card limits tie to budget balances, and independent or hands-on corroboration of enforcement working in practice (evidence is entirely vendor marketing and API docs).
